title: senecio canescens
intro: Senecio canescens, commonly known as woolly groundsel, is a type of flowering plant in the daisy family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Senecio canescens include expectorant, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, making it useful for relieving coughs, sore throats, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Senecio canescens include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
